SEARCH
Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.platform

Interface PlatformService

public interface PlatformService
What the installed Zentrix is and what it can do on this server.

Use it to decide on prerequisites before registering content: a method that exists in the API can still be unavailable because of the installed edition, a missing or outdated dependency, or the server's configuration. getCapability(String) says which, and whether it may change without touching the installation.

Example


 PlatformService platform = ZentrixAPI.get().getPlatformService();
 CapabilityStatus gliders = platform.getCapability(ZentrixCapabilities.GLIDER_DEPLOYMENT);
 if (!gliders.isAvailable()) {
     getLogger().info("Sky drops will fall without a glider: " + gliders.reason());
 }

No secret is ever exposed here: no license key, database credential or connection string. Every method may be called from any thread; the answers are snapshots.

Since:
1.8.0

    • registerCapability

      @NotNull @NotNull CapabilityRegistration registerCapability(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin owner, @NotNull @NotNull String id, @NotNull @NotNull Supplier<CapabilityStatus> status)
      Reports a capability of the caller's own, so other addons can depend on it the same way they depend on Zentrix's.

      The id must be namespaced, namespace:name, and may not use the zentrix namespace. The supplier is asked whenever the capability is read, on the reader's thread, so it must be cheap and thread-safe; the id and provider of what it returns are replaced with the registered ones. A supplier that throws reports CapabilityState.FAILED.

      Parameters:
      owner - the reporting plugin; the registration ends when it is disabled
      id - the namespaced capability id
      status - the capability's current status
      Returns:
      the registration
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the id is not namespaced, uses the zentrix namespace, or is already registered by an enabled plugin
